title: 第13章 寿终正寝大礼包第14章 师姐自重师弟我是正经人
slug: 这个主角明明很强却异常谨慎
content_zh:
二者交战，刹那间爆发出强横的灵气。
漆黑魔气与赤红神焰相撞，整片森林被两种力量吞噬。
已跑出数千米的郑拓，在感受到身后的对决后……加速，在加速。
太不谨慎了，太不谨慎了。
二阶修仙者对抗三阶魔修，简直就是饿狗下茅房——找屎。
突然！
身后传来一股热量。
一道倩影，咻的一声，从他身边飞过。
随后狠狠摔在他面前。
“噗……”
赤枭口吐鲜血，眼露萎靡。
刚刚的英气全无，受了重伤。
一个回合，仅仅一个回合，赤枭便被击败。
魔修之强大，远超想象。
郑拓眼见如此。
二话不说，转身向另一个方向跑路。
管也没管受伤躺在自己面前的赤枭。
我自顾都不暇，老妹儿你自求多福吧。
赤枭忍着伤痛起身。
美眸看了一眼玩命跑路，看都没看自己一眼的郑拓。

忍住心中火气。
转头，看向踏空而来的魔九。
没有言语，化为一道赤光，在次冲向魔九。
“有性格，我喜欢。”
魔九望着无所畏惧冲杀而来的赤枭，舔舔嘴唇，眼中满是欣赏。
魔族以强者为尊，不像人族，尊师重道。
魔族之中，实力强就是王。
你可以抢夺你想要的一切，包括女人。
狠狠一拳。
没有任何花哨的神通。
“嘭……”
赤枭在次被轰飞。
真魔形态的他，曾击杀过四阶魔修。
小小二阶修仙者，他从未放在眼里。
郑拓跑路中。
突然！
耳旁传来呼啸之音。
“咻……”
“嘭……”
赤枭从空中划出一道优雅的弧线。

“啪叽……”
摔在郑拓脚边。
这一次赤枭显得更加狼狈。
身上鲜红的赤羽战甲破损多处。
露出里面雪白的皮肤。
content_en:
The two fought, and a powerful spiritual energy burst out in an instant.
The dark demonic energy collided with the red divine flame, and the entire forest was swallowed up by the two forces.
Zheng Tuo, who had already run several thousand meters, felt the duel behind him...accelerating, accelerating.
Too imprudent, too imprudent.
When a second-level immortal cultivator fights against a third-level demon cultivator, it is like a hungry dog ​​going down to the latrine - looking for shit.
Sudden!
There was a heat coming from behind.
A beautiful shadow flew past him with a hiss.
Then he fell hard in front of him.
"Pfft..."
Red Owl vomited blood from his mouth and his eyes were droopy.
His heroic spirit just now was gone and he was seriously injured.
In one round, just one round, Red Owl was defeated.
The power of demon cultivators is far beyond imagination.
Zheng Tuo saw this.
Without saying anything, he turned around and ran in the other direction.
He didn't care about the injured Red Owl lying in front of him.
I don't have time to take care of myself, little sister, just wish yourself well.
Chi Xiao endured the pain and stood up.
Mei Mu glanced at Zheng Tuo, who was running away without even looking at herself.
Hold back your anger.
Turning his head, he looked at Mo Jiu who was coming through the air.
Without words, it turned into a red light and rushed towards Mo Jiu.
"It has character, I like it."
Mo Jiu looked at the red owl charging fearlessly, licking his lips, his eyes full of appreciation.
The Demon Clan respects the strong, unlike the Human Clan, which respects teachers and Taoism.
Among the demons, the strongest is the king.
You can grab everything you want, including women.
A hard punch.
No fancy magical powers.
"Bang..."
The red owl was blown away again.
In his true demon form, he once killed a fourth-level demon cultivator.
He never looked down upon the little second-level immortal cultivator.
Zheng Tuo is running away.
Sudden!
There was a whistling sound in my ears.
"Phew..."
"Bang..."
The red owl drew an elegant arc from the sky.
"Paji..."
He fell at Zheng Tuo's feet.
This time Red Owl looked even more embarrassed.
The bright red Akabane armor on his body was damaged in many places.
Revealing the snow-white skin underneath.
